gaps: The updated OWN-01 test (t287-held-owner-fold-reuse) was not run in this window, and neither was the rest of the affected regression set (owned-call-reference, held-prefix, ordered reconstruction, calculus/EC continuation, runtime-failure, terminal-quiescence, project-read). Existing tests that count bodyDecodes may change, because basis bodies no handle covers are no longer kept in RuntimeHistory.#verifiedBodies.

The 50-call workload (ABG_RC10_BASIS_LIFETIME_MODE=workload50) was not run. It was skipped by explicit mode selection and belongs to the separate frozen proof, so heap observations are not executed either.

Rollback disposal (RuntimeHistory.truncate and the append-failure path) is implemented but no test drives an actual failed append. No duplicate-row (many) case was built. No foreign case was run beyond the copied-history check.

No test exercised refusal, admitted runtime failure, interruption, failed output/recovery or held/gap exits of an actual Run, or continuation reacquisition. Only successful completed Runs, plus direct use of the owner handle API, were executed.

Not proven by execution: that a start Run's call.invocation.invocationRef equals its basis payload invocationRef. Active retention inside a real Run was not observed directly. If the refs differ, there is no lifetime breach, but reuse during an active Run would be lost.
The new test checks historyBasisBodies only as <=1 with matching bytes, not exactly 1.
The functional test does not assert completed-Run work counters (rowAdmissions per Run). It asserts only that gauges are zero after each Run.

Package/manifest correspondence, public export and native-locator gates were exercised only to the extent the frozen stage's generate/imports/lifecycle/calculus steps cover them. No separate package verification was run.

Unused imports that predate this work were left in place: c_call selectValidatedRuntimeEventPrefix, event_store ROOT_CURRENT_EVENT_PROFILE_REF, invocation_admission selectValidatedRuntimeEventPrefix. Removing gap_authority's value import of product/index drops one runtime module edge; no runtime test of that was run beyond the build gates.
Strict child-level eviction is not implemented (not selected). The bound is only that completed operations retain nothing.
Scratch writes were limited to qualification-scratch/rc10-retention-01/proof-01 (tsc-*.txt, driver logs, driver outputs). This does not establish that no writes happened elsewhere.
report.summary:
RC10 source frozen once (sourceDigest 86e9de76d65a61d9d9ae392dc2591217df8c4d3e5827699fd7f30befbfe6dd34). The frozen build passed: compile, generate, imports, lifecycle and calculus all exited 0. The single focused run also passed: the new lifetime test's functional case passed, and the 50-call workload case was skipped on purpose because it needs explicit mode selection.

HOW was written before any code: ABI5_COMMON §10.12 gained an "O1 lifetime (RC10)" section plus Observation and Proof updates. I removed "duplicate" from the false proof sentence, and changed one line of the STDO3_BINDING lifetime sentence (the optional edit, because the existing sentence was affected). In M05 only the Public run projection authority Update/Transition cell changed: a changed close pair now requires a new immutable authority built by constructPublicRunProjectionAuthority from that pair and the same Run/Product basis, with no mutation and no append or execution power.

Lifetime design and owner methods:
- RuntimeHistory (one per store, cleared at each generation boundary) now holds per-invocation handle counts, checked basis rows keyed by generation:eventId:ordinal, and retained basis body indices. New methods: retainBasis, basisRowFact, retainBasisRowFact, disposeBasisRetention, observeBasisRetention.
- In RuntimeHistory.event(), a basis_admitted body is kept in #verifiedBodies only while an open handle holds its invocation. Otherwise it stays in the consumer-local selectedBodies map. Other event kinds are unchanged.
- execution_basis_record checkExecutionBasisRow no longer uses runtimePrefixComputation / EXECUTION_BASIS_ROW_FACTS. It resolves membership and cardinality first, then retains a row only through runtimePrefixBasisRetention(owned prefix) under an open handle. Arrays, copies, validation views and reads with no open handle check cold. Only one-results are retained, and the full return contract is unchanged.
- event_prefix gains retainExecutionBasisLifetime(DurablePrefixCoordinate, invocationRef). It goes through the new event_store activeRuntimeHistoryAtDurablePrefix, which uses only DurableHistoryDerivation.activeSelection. A cold, closed or copied coordinate opens nothing, and no durable coordinate is passed as a RuntimeEventPrefix.
- run_invocation adds a retainBasisLifetime helper using Effect.acquireRelease inside the existing Effect.scoped of runInvocationOwner (called invocation, opened right after resource acquisition) and of runCurrentIntentOwner, runSelectedActionOwner and runPendingExecutionOwner (prepared original invocation: prepared.invocation or use.invocation, never the continuation operation's own ref). Release runs on every exit, before abandon.
- Disposal: RuntimeHistory.truncate, releaseDurableOwnership (close/abandon) and the append-failure rollback call disposeBasisRetention. This bumps an epoch, so old handles cannot release or re-register.
- runtime_derivation.ts and definition_event_resource.ts are unchanged. There is no new registry, WeakRef or tombstone.

Counters contract: observeRuntimeHistoryBasisRetention(selection) reports openHandles, retainedRows, retainedPayloadBytes, historyBasisBodies and historyBasisPayloadBytes. These are current owner gauges, not cumulative totals. Byte figures are the logical UTF-8 length of the canonical JSON of rawInputValue, recorded once at insertion and summed at observation without rescanning; they are not heap, RSS or allocation size. The workload mode reports heap separately. The existing work counters rowAdmissions and bodyDigests are kept.

Dead code: all 23 pinned declarations in 17 files were deleted after exact span and file-preimage sha256 checks. I also removed adjacent comments (event_prefix, runtime_history, project_read_ports ×2, public_function_contracts, qualification_proof) and the imports these deletions left unused (invocation_admission 1, project_read_ports 4, gap_authority 8 including a value import of product/index, run_projection_authority 1). The two semantic_revision realizations were not touched. The core work reused none of the deleted helpers.

Other edits: OWN-01 now expects completed historical rows to be checked cold and to be equal but not the same object. New test t287-held-basis-lifetime.test.mjs: functional mode (default) covers completed Runs, cold historical reads, an active handle, earlier-cut and copied prefixes, overlapping and same-invocation handles, double release and close. workload50 mode runs 50 calls with compact per-call records and sentinel reads. Version identity bumped from rc.9 to exact 5.0.0-rc.10 in package.json, package-lock.json and contracts.ts. All five pinned pre-freeze tsc runs ended exit 0 after fixes.

Receipts (all under qualification-scratch/rc10-retention-01/proof-01): frozen-proof/stage-01/source-freeze.json, frozen-proof/stage-01/RESULT.json (BUILT), frozen-proof/focused-01/RESULT.json (PASSED, 1 pass, 1 skip, 37s), plus tsc-1..5.txt, stage-driver.log and focused-driver.log.

Changed paths, tenant-relative: the 3 design files above; code/src abg/{calculus/execution_basis_record, event_prefix, event_store, runtime_history, c_call, invocation_admission, project_read_ports, qualification_proof}.ts, owner_bindings/run_invocation.ts, product/{contracts, semantic_job}.ts, public/{gap_authority, run_projection_authority}.ts, shared/{operation_definition_coordinate, public_function_contracts}.ts, validator/validation.ts, hog/{traversal_failure, traversal_completion}.ts, implementation/leaf_invocation_port.ts, gtl/stdo_run_environment.ts; package.json; package-lock.json; test_env/tests/t287-held-owner-fold-reuse.test.mjs; and the new test_env/tests/t287-held-basis-lifetime.test.mjs. No source edits were made after the freeze.
